context.purpose: Notice the target in a meaningful original Yomu situation before being asked to use it.

instruction.form: plain adjective or noun + だ / どこか / 何か
instruction.meaning: make an informal plan while leaving a place or activity open
instruction.commonContrast: どこか and 何か mean an unspecified option, not a specific place or object

workedExamples.en: An original Yomu context model; use it to notice the target before creating your own response.

guidedPractice.prompt: First find the target in context. Then make a parallel attempt from a cue; the completed response remains hidden until after the attempt.

progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use plain adjective or noun + だ / どこか / 何か; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries make an informal plan while leaving a place or activity open.
Compare your form, meaning, and casual planning with friends with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.

retryFeedback.diagnostic: Check the form and meaning again. A common mix-up is this: どこか and 何か mean an unspecified option, not a specific place or object
retryFeedback.retryPrompt: Revise one part at a time, then try again with your own content.
